What is Atlas?

Atlas is PlotNua's research layer — it checks real, published specifications for every product before anything is matched to your project.

What it verified

  • Every match is drawn from real Atlas evidence — published prices, verified dimensions, confirmed specifications.

Why Trust PlotNua?

  • No paid rankings. Suppliers cannot pay PlotNua for a better position.
  • If PlotNua ever earns a referral fee for an introduction, it never affects which options are shown or how they're ordered.
  • Uncertainties are always labelled honestly — never hidden or smoothed over.

This isn't a claim that any option physically fits your garden yet, and these are directions to explore, not a ranking.

    Before You Decide

      Garden Rooms & Planning

      Good news. Many modern garden rooms may not require a full planning application. Let's check whether yours could qualify.

      PlotNua will help you check the important things — including size, height, position and intended use — against the garden room you are considering.

      Choose a garden room to start your check.

      Planning History Near This Property

      Checking nearby planning records…

      A few practical things worth thinking through for a garden room.

      Can materials and installation equipment reach the garden?

      Where is the nearest practical electrical connection?

      Relevant where the intended use needs a sink, bathroom, kitchen or other services.

      Slope, paving, drainage and foundation requirements may affect installation and cost.

      Windows, overlooking, noise and proximity to neighbouring properties may matter.

      Particularly relevant for clients, guests, tenants or independent use.

      Year-round use changes the specification required.

      Relevant particularly for accommodation, food-related and certain commercial uses.

      Which of these matter most depends on what you choose to create — PlotNua will help narrow this down.
